steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Boss, Penguin Logistics is on the move.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Of course. I just gave her a few skin deep cuts...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But I'm more worried about Capone.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Y- yeah, we haven't been able to reach him. Tried real hard an hour ago.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Where's the last place you got him? The slums?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Er, yeah.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's too bad.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Tell all the crews, we're going with the original plan to get Penguin Logistics...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But I'm thinkin'... unless something goes wrong, we'll get two or three crews dropping off the grid.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What do you mean... boss?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Couldn't be... Capone betrayed the Family?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I get where he's comin' from. All too well.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We grew up together. And dad had us deal with a traitor, with our own two hands. That was my first time takin' a life. Our first time takin' a life.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The Siracusa fiasco changed us. The only difference is he turned weak, and I chose the clear path.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: He's gonna sell out the Family. Or I guess he wants to give the Family a new name.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: So what should we do about it?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is turning out trickier than I thought. And we can't fight a war on too many fronts.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I'm thinkin' we deal with our traitor problem first.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I'm down at the intersection. Nothing special here.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Roger. Proceed as usual.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: W- wait! What's the plan here?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Huh? You screwed up something?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: No, I just wanna be sure. I really don't know Lungmen at all.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: It's Sauin. When midnight rolls around, Lungmen kicks off a huge Carnival. The whole town turns out. That's when we rub out Penguin Logistics. Bada bing!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Now about the boss...

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Don't ask too many questions. Just do what you're told. Chop-chop.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...it's what it is.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You ain't gonna kill me, are you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course not. But you gotta take a nap for me like a good boy~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas, you copy?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's the same over here. They all split off into little groups.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But their leader was in the fight himself, which means they've got someone else handing out dispatch orders.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We just have to cut off that head.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey~ Texas?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We're in the city center, but boy are there a lot of people out here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Watch for the enemy. They're moving in small teams.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I know~ We'll make sure our friends on the street keep an eye out... Wait, boss? You want to get up on a float? Erm, wait for me...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant, Bison, do you copy?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So you were talking about that someone else giving dispatch orders, we ran into a little surprise over here.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Bison, get down. Take cover behind that box over there. Don't get yerself seen.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right. I'll call you back, Texas.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: So where do we go from here?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: I dunno. Since we cut off the boss... since we cut off Gambino Ricci, we really don't have a choice.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What's to sigh about? Mr. Capone did so much for us here in Lungmen, and what came of it?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Gambino hops on over from Siracusa and makes nothin' but trouble. Not a lick of good's come of him!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: If we kept to Mr. Capone's plan from the start, we wouldn't be in this mess.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: We've been over this with the Rat King. Why do we gotta kill anybody? This ain't Siracusa!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: The boss, I mean the old boss, he's probably just blowin' off steam.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Well he needs to grow up.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Sounds like trouble in paradise.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Sure does. This could be good for us, if we...)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Hey! Who's there?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? A gunshot?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's that sniper again! We're exposed!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: It's the Penguins! Don't let 'em get away!

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: ...Do forgive me, Young Master. This is what the Master of the House has demanded of me.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: But in taking action upon the Young Master, I have placed him in danger...

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: When this matter is concluded, I believe it may be time to retire to the countryside.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Sounds like they're in trouble.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, once you've marked out the gangsters' route, move to meet up with Croissant.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it~

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Whew... the bad guys are making a lot of moves, but it looks like they're splitting into two teams. Might be a trap...

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: It is not so complicated. The enemy is suffering from internal strife. This is an opportunity.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Aaaie! You scared me!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Welcome back.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why'd you have to hack into our private channel? Couldn't you just send us a normal message?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: This was quicker.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Where are you now?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: A depressing cafe. I suddenly remembered I was supposed to have today off, so I came out to enjoy the nightlife.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: I've sent you Croissant and the new boy's coordinates. Lungmen's network speeds are remarkably satisfactory.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...understood. Once we've finished our respective missions, we'll move to assist them.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This is our chance to strike back.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Capone, the boss's hit on Penguin Logistics looks like it failed.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What's that meathead worth? I don't even wanna hear his name.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...Is that how we do it?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The Family needs a solid foundation. The name is the least important part.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Did you find the Rat King yet?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Not yet. He really don't leave any tracks around...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We gotta be patient. He's like a part of the city. He's Lungmen's shadow. It ain't like we got much time though.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: But we gotta be careful. If the Rat King picks up on what we're doin', we could find ourselves fighting three sides at once.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's the same for everyone. If we're locked into a tough spot, the best thing to do is stir up some chaos.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You got news of Gambino?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You deaf?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: If you got somethin' to say to me, shouldn't you just say it to my face?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: How did you get in here?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Not everybody's like you. Not everybody can just up and turn their back on an oath made before dad's grave.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Oath? That's just because we were walking the same path. But times have changed, Gambino.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You broke my heart, Capone. But I'll give you one last chance to explain yourself, as my brother.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hmph. Seven years ago, when we buried the old boss, you sent me here, to Lungmen.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I came halfway across the world to set up a business that could support the Family, like a backstop.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But then you had to go and screw up in Siracusa. And what do you do? You hop on over here and take over everything I broke my back to build.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Come on, you ain't gettin' pissed off over some little shit like this. Or you'd've been dead a long time ago.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Say what you want. But today I learned the sharpest fangs in the Family's what's gonna turn around and kill it.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So you gonna pull out your fangs and snap a collar on yourself? Hah!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If you keep runnin' around Lungmen makin' noise like you do, sooner or later the powers that be are gonna get sick of it and wipe us out.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Your deep and heartfelt concern for the Family is moving me to tears, dear Capone.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The feeling's mutual.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're rusty.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The scars you got in Siracusa are holding you back too.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Just give up. I don't wanna kill you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No, you really do.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Heh. You know me too well.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Wh——

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well lookie here! I just wanted to bust through this wall and make a nice path... but it looks like I found quite a sight.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sorry to bother ya. You two keep at it. We'll go around.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Hurry! Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I think we're out of options.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: How about that. Our troublemakers came right to us. We'll just scoop you up and——

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: What is it this time?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heyy~ We're heere!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What a coincidence, running into everyone.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So, is it time for a final battle already? Seems a little early?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's fine. The sooner we get this whole thing over with, the better.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just throw them in the river, like the boss said.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This kind of chaos is just the way I like it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Tonight's big winner is the one who walks out of here alive.
